name: Baalah
overview: The name Baalah appears in Scripture as a designation for multiple locations within the territory of Judah, including a southern city, a northern city also known as Kirjath-Jearim, and a mountain likely identical with Mount Jearim. Joshua 15 records Baalah in the southern border descriptions of Judah, highlighting its geographical significance near Mount Seir, Bethshemesh, and Timnah. Additionally, Baalah is mentioned alongside other towns like Iim and Azem, emphasizing its role within the tribal allotments. These references collectively show Baalah as an important landmark within the tribal boundaries assigned to Judah.
